description: This file defines the `Zend_Http_UserAgent_Probe` class which extends `Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice`. It includes methods for matching user agent signatures to determine device type, and for defining feature capabilities such as images, iframes, frames, and JavaScript support. The class is primarily responsible for probing and identifying browser or device types based on user agent signatures within the Zend Framework's HTTP package.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Probe
classes.description: A class that probes user agent strings to identify device types and capabilities using predefined signatures.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Compares the user agent string against known signatures to determine a match.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of device, which is 'probe'.

methods.name: _defineFeatures
methods.description: Defines features supported by the device, such as images, iframes, frames, and JavaScript, all set to false in this probe.
